title: Mrs and Mrs: The Podcast
author: Mrs. and Mrs: The Podcast
description: YO, we're Shellez and Treva! We've been married for two years and after a rocky first year of marriage we realized we needed some ADVICE to help our marriage survive. We are a black lesbian married couple and we were looking for podcasts targeted to SGL couples and the unique needs of couples from the LGBTQIA+ community. While there were a number of podcasts that provided content for married couples, few addressed the lives and needs of LBGTQ married couples and far fewer spoke to the experiences of black and people of color in the community. So we made the podcast we needed!
